q: Before Taiwan's January 2028 election, the China Coast Guard sustains boarding inspections of vessels or navigation controls in the waters of outlying islands such as Kinmen and Matsu for seven days or more
basis: Precedents: the 1958 artillery blockade of Kinmen and China Coast Guard patrols around Kinmen since 2024 · Checked against prior attempts, Taiwan Strait issue
rs: Statements by Taiwan's Coast Guard Administration and Reuters/AP reporting (to establish the duration)
